description: This source file defines an enumeration 'GatewayAutostartPolicy' with static functions to determine whether to start a gateway and ensure launching an agent based on application state and pause status.

methods.name: shouldStartGateway
methods.description: Determines if the gateway should start based on connection mode and paused state.

methods.name: shouldEnsureLaunchAgent
methods.description: Determines if the launch agent should be ensured, delegating based on the same parameters as shouldStartGateway.
